summary: Independent falsification pass does not overturn the current GEV structural thesis, but identifies valuation/execution sensitivity and concentration of official scoring into a single publishable company as major confidence constraints. XTND's newly registered equity-plan share pool is a concrete dilution/overhang risk that should be resolved before admission. No bearish conclusion is manufactured where evidence is incomplete.

materialFindings.finding: Earth's official baseline remains extremely narrow: system state shows 250 observed/validated companies but only one scored and publishable company. Any apparent portfolio-level confidence is therefore premature even if GEV itself is well evidenced.

GEV's own causal model contains a falsifiable dependence on sustained power/data-center demand and continued equipment scarcity. This is appropriately explicit, but current graph coverage is company-centric and does not yet encode substitute supply responses or permitting/interconnection constraints as separate competing nodes.

External analyst evidence shows the GEV bull case itself requires sustained high gas-turbine demand/margins; Rothschild Redburn noted current prices were difficult to justify on DCF without sustained high margins even while upgrading the stock. This is a valuation/execution challenge, not a refutation of long-horizon Earth quality.

XTND registered 43,567,442 shares on Form S-8 immediately after the merger, including 18,630,959 under its 2026 equity plan and 15,000,000 under its ESPP. Without denominator normalization this cannot be labeled excessive dilution, but it is material enough to block any clean capital-structure assumption.

proposedCanonicalChanges.proposal: Do not change GEV Earth Score from this pass. Add targeted research for substitute supply/capacity normalization and demand-permitting constraints before increasing causal confidence further.
Require fully diluted capitalization and financing-runway review as an XTND admission prerequisite.

contradictions.issue: GEV has Earth Score 81.8 and data confidence 92.4 while the baseline universe has only one scored company. Company-level confidence may be justified, but rank-relative confidence cannot yet be inferred from a one-company comparable set.

unknowns: How quickly competing turbine/grid-equipment suppliers can add capacity and compress scarcity rents.
Degree to which data-center permitting, interconnection, labor or AI-demand moderation can delay GEV backlog conversion.
XTND fully diluted denominator, cash runway and post-merger financing requirements.
No evidence in this pass establishes accounting misconduct, promotional management or fraud at GEV or XTND.
peerRequests: structural-causal: model supply-response and permitting/interconnection nodes as potential falsifiers of the GEV scarcity thesis.
company-underwriting: calculate XTND fully diluted share count and financing runway from merger/pro-forma filings.
expectations-execution: quantify GEV valuation sensitivity to margin normalization without contaminating Earth Score.

accuracyDebates.topic: Distinguish company evidence confidence from rank-relative confidence while fewer than a meaningful comparable set are officially scored.
Make dilution denominator normalization mandatory before interpreting large S-8 registrations as benign or bearish.
